chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Aamir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Al-Husayn ibn Asad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Yaqthan, (it was) raised to them (peace be upon him), who said:

The man should say when he has finished with the Adhan and is seated: 'O Allah, make my heart righteous, my livelihood constant, my sustenance continuous, and make for me a dwelling and a resting place near the grave of Your Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).'
ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited after finishing the Adhan?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi highlights the spiritual etiquette of remaining seated after the Adhan to engage in intimate supplication, emphasizing the transition from public proclamation to private devotion. It specifically requests a 'pure heart' (Qalb Barir) and 'stable livelihood' (Aish Qarir), reflecting the Shia emphasis on inner tranquility and divine provision as prerequisites for worship. The request for a permanent resting place near the Prophet’s grave underscores the high status of the Ahl al-Bayt and the concept of intercession and proximity to the Prophet in the afterlife.
